contract.method: authored native behavior contract with independent JS reference
contract.description: Return ceil(value / step) multiplied by step. This rounds toward positive infinity, including for negative values. Preserve binary floating-point behavior.
contract.domain: Numeric arguments are finite, between -1000 and 1000, with no negative-zero inputs. Inputs are unchanged. Step is from 0.1 through 100.
contract.outputRole: smallest step multiple not below value in the specified floating computation
contract.mutationPolicy: Do not modify inputs; array outputs must be fresh with independent storage.
